failures.detail: no call matches /^workit approve ap_[a-z2-7]{8}$/: the refusal says to run the plain approve call so the host asks the user

#3 Bash(workit approve ap_owgiz2h3 2>&1) matches /workit approve ap_[^\n]*(&&|\|\||;|\||\$\(|`|>)|(&&|\|\||;|\|)\s*workit approve ap_|^\s*\S+=\S*\s+workit approve|workit --cwd \S+ approve/: a chain, substitution, env prefix or --cwd around workit approve is denied: the host records nothing
